subject: Theorem A (Clausen–Scholze)
object: Ext^i_{Cond(Ab)}(M_{p'}(S), V) = 0 for all i >= 1, for 0 < p' < p <= 1, S a profinite set, V a p-Banach space considered as a condensed abelian group
